name: Cornavii
text: Cornavii is the name Ptolemy records in the second century for a people of Caithness in northern Scotland. Readers have taken the name as people of the promontory, people of the horn, or people of the horned god. No single reading has won agreement.

attributes.attribute: people of Caithness named by Ptolemy

okr.objective: Record the Ptolemaic name for a people of Caithness.
key_results: Give the name as Ptolemy's record for a Caithness people.
